questions.q: On which day of May 1857 did the sepoy mutiny break out at Meerut? (give the day as a number)

What cartridge grievance triggered the Meerut outbreak? (one word)
Besides sepoys, which rural groups joined the spreading rebellion? (two groups)

By what medium of word of mouth did the revolt travel across north India? (one word)
Rebels believed greased cartridges would defile their what? (one word)
Rumour said flour was kneaded with what substance? (two words)

What happened to rebel villages under British repression? (one word)

Which visual records of 1857 were made by contemporary artists on both sides? (one word)

Commemorative images of punishments like the blowing of sepoys served whose memory? (short phrase)
What kind of records, visual or written, spread news of rebel visions? (one word)
Whose exile and trial became a subject of later nationalist remembrance? (three words)
In which year did the revolt break out at Meerut? (give the year)

How many years passed between the outbreak at Meerut and the Act transferring rule to the Crown? (number of years)
How many years after the battle of Plassey (1757) did the revolt of 1857 begin? (number of years)
